sources.title: EHDS — European Health Data Space
sources.why: Sets the EU framework and EEHRxF format for exchanging electronic health data and interoperating with EHRs across borders.

sources.title: eHealth — national profiles (EPRA, DMP, ELGA)
sources.why: Governs reading from and writing to national EHRs, requiring FHIR plus national identifiers and secure messaging for data exchange.
